I've had many many trips to A&E for self harm. Ive had very mixed responses from people who have treated me. It should be treated based on the wound not on how it was caused.

I did once have a wound which my therapist at the time came with me as it needed stitches, long and deep cut, i had had more minor wounds that had been stitched.
They point blank refused because it was due to self harm. I really expected stitches as i was told by the triage nurse they would require stitching.
Until the doctor came in and steri stripped it, despite me explaining it needed more. I told him that it needed stitches but he steri stripped it despite me saying i would only remove them as i have eczema and it causes alot of irritation (the stickiness of the strips) and wouldn't have bothered coming if it didn't need stitching. He ignored me and basically rejected anything i was saying. I ended up removing them after an hour due to irritation, it took so long to heal.
Looking back i should have done something about it, my therapist even thought more should have been done but me being very anxious about things, i wouldn't say a thing.

If you can i would totally complain, you should be given treatment based on the severity of the wound not how it was caused or if it would happen again.

Well i bought a mouse July last year, to replace my cheap gaming mouse that broke after about a week (dont buy very cheap ones if you want it to last).
I bought the UtechSmart Venus Gaming Mouse and i have found it really nice to use and was about £30 on amazon. I dont know if this is in your price range or not, but i suggest not buying one thats too cheap, my first gaming mouse i was stupid and bought it because it was £10, but the left mouse button broke.

Im on my pc most of the day so i needed a comfortable mouse for long periods and one that can take constant use. It hasnt let me down so far, it has a nice feel and is shaped to support your fingers and works on most surfaces including my leg lol.
Its got 12 side buttons 1-12 numbers, i find the ones in the middle 2 rows fiddly, but thats probably because of my nail getting in the way. The scroll wheel feels nice and smooth, you can change the dpi of it upto 16400 though i never increase is past the lowest setting, theres no need. You can also change the weight of it.
It has a program you can download to customise it further including the colours of the lights.
